voice_name: Dime (ElevenLabs library: American male narrator, deep, dynamic pacing)

reference.clip: IQ 160 video (smartest person is probably broke)

notes: DEFAULT = male ElevenLabs narrator (the user rejected the female voices and the free local voice). Dime picked from the library: deepest (103 Hz) with the most pitch movement (10.2 st) of 6 American male storytellers. Needs ~1 credit per character on eleven_v3 (a 60 s script ~ 1,200). Free fallback: male_free.

free_alternative.engine: chatterbox (MIT, local, expressive; keeps Resemble's AI watermark)
free_alternative.note: A Kokoro clip as --voice made it monotone (6.6 st). Prefer expressiveness.

male_free.voice_ref: Kokoro am_onyx clip (Apache-2.0), made with tts_kokoro.py --voice am_onyx --speed 1.0 on any neutral ~9 s paragraph
male_free.note: Deep male storyteller. With --ex 0.8 a male Kokoro reference stays expressive (11-12.6 st), unlike the old female test (6.6 st at --ex 0.55).
male_free.process: silenceremove(-38dB, keep 0.06 s) -> pitch_shift -> atempo 1.15 -> post_filter  (the user wanted it deeper and faster: ~94 Hz, ~215 wpm)
